title: Dual Momentum Between Gold and Bitcoin (Two Stores of Value) [Aligrithm]
description: class="qo-content-col"> Dual Momentum Between Gold and Bitcoin (Two Stores of Value) [Aligrithm] An 8-week dual-momentum switch between GLD and IBIT returns 79.91% a year at a Sharpe of 1.64. Vojtko and Dujava report that number on a Quantpedia note covering 31 December
